verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm with a client portal for uploading documents, messaging and tracking case status. A natural-language or AI command interface to that service is conceivable, so the axis applies, but no evidence shows one exists. The llms.txt file only exposes site content to AI crawlers and is not a way to operate the product, and talking with a human attorney is not natural-language command operation of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
